method: Public YouTube searches for every approved addition, with local-name aliases. Selected paragliding, hang-gliding and explicitly labelled related free-flight footage. Public YouTube watch metadata and oEmbed verify video titles and availability. No video has been pre-approved by the owner.
matching: site means the name/description identifies the site or mountain, not its exact launch. area means range, foothills, overflight or landing only; the exact marked launch is not confirmed. One Galtee-range video appears for two nearby candidates and requires separate review at each site.
excluded: Unrelated same-name foreign places, walking-only, drone-only, powered overflights and clearly different neighbouring launches were omitted. No search result is treated as a verified wind direction.
